title: Rilevazione flusso veicoli tramite spire - anno 2024 (Comune di Bologna open data)
summary: Hourly vehicle counts per road loop counter (spira) in the city of Bologna, Italy, for calendar year 2024, with the geographic position of each counter. The portal notes that a counter's code can change over time, so one physical loop may appear under several codes; the id_uni field links them. Traffic is flagged with an accuracy parameter that is documented in a separate 2024 accuracy dataset. This is a Bologna source, not Valdena client traffic, and it covers only 2024.

fields.name: codice spira
fields.description: Loop/counter code; can change over time for the same physical loop (per meta_description)

fields.name: id_uni
fields.description: Stable identifier linking records of the same physical loop across code changes (per meta_description)

fields.name: livello
fields.description: Level number (1, 2, 3...) distinguishing successive codes of the same loop (per meta_description)

fields.name: ID_univoco_stazione_spira
fields.description: Unique identifier of the loop station, recommended as the unique key (per meta_description)

fields.name: accuratezza
fields.description: Accuracy parameter for hourly traffic counts, accounting for counter malfunction (per text_start); see separate 2024 accuracy dataset

documentation_excerpts: Rilevazione oraria degli autoveicoli tramite spire e loro posizione geografica.
Si evidenzia inoltre che il codice spira può cambiare nel tempo, pertanto è possibile trovare nella stessa posizione geografica più elementi sovrapposti ma che rappresentano la stessa spira.

I dati del traffico per fascia oraria sono caratterizzati da un parametro definito accuratezza che tiene conto dell'eventuale malfunzionamento delle spire e quindi della valutazione errata del traffico rilevato.
quality_notes: No data links or distributions were exposed on the landing page (data_links and jsonld_datasets empty), so no data file was sampled. Schema and value sets are unverified.
Loop codes change over time: the same physical loop can appear at several positions with different 'codice spira' values; id_uni must be used to link them (per meta_description).
Hourly counts carry an accuracy parameter for counter malfunction; records with poor accuracy need filtering. The accuracy dataset for 2024 is a separate dataset not profiled here.
Coverage is 2024 only, so it cannot supply the 2025 part of the production window; it is also a different city from the client (Valdena).
Page footer shows 'Copyright © 2020', and 'Last processing' metadata was not extracted, so the currency of the data is unknown.
Candidate note says the page licence is CC BY 4.0; this was confirmed in the page text but the dataset-level licence was not separately read.
